# Never Stop Moving Movers

> Moving company based in Austin, Texas. Julio and his crew move houses, apartments and offices across Austin, often on a day's notice. TVs, artwork, safes and breakables get wrapped and handled like they're ours.

- Phone: (512) 701-8153
- Based in: Austin, TX
- Service area: Austin, Round Rock, Pflugerville, Cedar Park, Leander, Georgetown
- Google rating: 5.0 from 53 reviews

## Services
- Home & apartment moves: Houses, apartments and townhomes, from the ground floor to the 15th, wrapped and loaded with care.
- Office & commercial moves: Office furniture and heavy but fragile equipment, moved on time and handled politely.
- Same-day & short notice: Moving tomorrow? Customers have called the day before, even on a Sunday, and Julio fit them in.
- Packing & wrapping: Blankets, stretch wrap and cardboard on everything that matters: TVs, art, glass and wood.
- Gun safes, pianos & antiques: The heavy, awkward and irreplaceable pieces, right on the side of our truck.
- Local & statewide: Across the Austin area, from Georgetown to The Domain to Kyle, and longer runs around Texas.

## About
Never Stop Moving Movers is an owner-operated moving company in North Austin, run by Julio. You'll know the truck: white box, big blue NEVER, and the list down the side: residential, commercial, local, statewide, gun safes, pianos, antiques. Julio picks up the phone himself and works the job with the crew. Customers keep saying the same things about him: he answers fast, he fits in moves on a day's notice, and he comes prepared. Floor runners go down first, furniture gets blankets and stretch wrap, TVs come off the wall boxed in cardboard, and the screws go in their own box so nothing gets lost. From a storage unit to a three-story townhome, from a house in Georgetown to a 15th-floor apartment at The Domain, or an office full of heavy equipment, the goal is the same: on time, polite, careful, done.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Can you move me on short notice?
  A: Often, yes. Customers have called us less than 24 hours before their move, even on a Sunday. Call (512) 701-8153 and we'll tell you what we can do.
- Q: Do you move gun safes and pianos?
  A: Yes. Gun safes, pianos and antiques are right on the side of our truck. Tell us the piece, the weight if you know it, and any stairs.
- Q: Will you pack and wrap my things?
  A: Yes. We put down floor runners, wrap furniture in blankets and stretch wrap, box TVs in cardboard after dismounting them, and keep screws and hardware together in a parts box.
- Q: Do you do office and commercial moves?
  A: Yes. We move office furniture and heavy, fragile equipment, and some business customers have used us more than once.
- Q: What areas do you cover?
  A: Austin and the towns around it: Round Rock, Pflugerville, Cedar Park, Leander, Georgetown, Lakeway, West Lake Hills, Buda and Kyle. We also take longer moves within Texas.
- Q: When can I call?
  A: Any time. Call or text Julio at (512) 701-8153, 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, or send a quote request. Quotes are free.
- Q: Do you haul junk too?
  A: Yes. Junk removal is part of what we do, on its own or alongside your move. Tell us what needs to go.
